_comment: Hearth's helpers that run as root and may be updated from the Hearth Store as system parts (hearth-system-part, docs/STORE-SYSTEM-PARTS.md). Only these ids are ever installed as root-owned parts; nothing that starts the PC (boot menu, Recovery, the login screen, units in the boot chain) is ever listed here: those come only with system updates. Decky plugins (decky: true) are here only for their test versions (red flag 13): hearth-decky puts the root-owned copy into Decky's plugins folder at Decky's next start, on trial, and a copy that doesn't load goes back to the one before by itself.
